messages:
amanda: Heads up — deploy-scheduler token rotation completed ~2m ago. Deploy-bot failing to fetch artifacts for canary promotions in gke-eu-west (pipeline #7421). 401 from GCS. Anyone oncall?

deploy-bot: ERROR: failed to download artifact gs://redwood-artifacts/sha-abc123.tar.gz — 401 Unauthorized. Attempt 3/5, backoff 8s :warning:

raj: oncall — looking. which cluster/zone and pipeline?

amanda: gke-eu-west, canary pipeline 7421. logs show "AccessDeniedException: 401" when gsutil tries to pull.

infra-ci-bot: run: ```gsutil cp gs://redwood-artifacts/sha-abc123.tar.gz /tmp/art.tar.gz
# => AccessDeniedException: 401
``` 

sofia: it's inside our change window but it's close to end; probably best to avoid a full rollback unless needed.

carl: security just rotated tokens, right? we shouldn't undo rotation. options: 1) temporary fallback to signed S3 urls for artifacts, 2) generate short-lived service account key for deploy-bot, 3) rollback canary to previous version to avoid promotion.

amanda: propose: pause promotions, rollback canary to v1.2.2, extend change window 90m, and generate a short-lived key for manual fixes. thoughts?

raj: +1 rollback canary. I can run rollback promote command once we approve. Also will add CI pin to prevent re-trigger until rotation done.

carol-security: don't roll back the token rotation — that's a security risk. Approve temporary SA key limited to artifact reads for deploy-bot only, logged and auto-rotated in 1h.

carl: generating key now, will post secure link. once key is created, we'll update deploy-bot secrets: `kubectl -n infra create secret generic deploybot-sa --from-literal=key=REDACTED --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -`

amanda: running rollback/pin now. running: `deploybot promote --from v1.2.2 --to canary --force --reason "artifact fetch failures"`

deploy-bot: Promotion started: canary <- v1.2.2. fetching artifact from fallback (s3 signed url)

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: canary at v1.2.2. artifacts fetched from fallback storage. :white_check_mark:

amanda: ok thanks. holding promotions until rotation validation done and CI pin applied. I'll update release notes and add a postmortem item. closing this thread after follow-up tasks.

raj: noted — I'll open a PR to pin the ci pipeline artifact resolver and add a smoke test for token-rotation.

carol-security: will rotate the short-lived key after 1h and follow up in #security.

amanda: thanks everyone, moving to postmortems & release notes.
